deprecation_criterion: Superseded by the next verify-integrate housekeep wave's baseline; single-use measured-reduction reference, re-captured whenever a feature wave legitimately extends the doc surface with load-bearing content.
description: Line counts of verify-integrate doc surfaces, re-baselined for the merge-sink URL observability fix wave (gh_pr_merge_sink derives a real PR web link via _pr_url instead of returning url:'', so a merged IntegrationResult entry carries a usable link). The housekeep e2e test asserts the current docs are NOT LARGER than these baselines (a reduced|no-op verdict) and that the load-bearing tokens survived.
